Entry Point 01

Automatic Enrolment Compliance

Compliance Automation

Pensions Act 2008 automatic enrolment compliance validation including qualifying scheme criteria, contribution rates, staging date adherence, and re-enrolment cycle management.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Detection of auto-enrolment non-compliance via employer contribution analysis, opt-out rate monitoring, and re-enrolment deadline tracking.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

Analysis of scheme documentation, employment contracts, and payroll records against TPR auto-enrolment guidance and qualifying scheme criteria.

Predictive Analytics

Auto-enrolment compliance risk scoring from employer size, sector, payroll complexity, and historical compliance patterns.

Evidence Synthesis

Payroll data, scheme records, and employer declarations into auto-enrolment compliance assessment dossiers.

Document Intelligence

Extraction from declaration of compliance forms, re-enrolment declarations, and scheme certification records.

Stakeholder Reporting

Auto-enrolment compliance dashboards showing employer compliance rates, contribution adequacy, and scheme quality metrics.

Real-time Monitoring

Staging date tracking, contribution payment monitoring, and re-enrolment cycle compliance verification.
